job.job_description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a Junior Engineer with 3-5 years of experience in Cloud Infrastructure and a working knowledge of AI tools. The ideal candidate will support cloud platform operations, infrastructure management, automation initiatives, and AI-enabled solutions to enhance operational efficiency and innovation.
Key Responsibilities
Manage, monitor, and support cloud infrastructure environments.
Assist in infrastructure provisioning, maintenance, and performance optimization.
Implement automation and operational improvements using cloud-native tools.
Leverage AI tools and technologies to improve productivity, monitoring, and operational workflows.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support project delivery and infrastructure initiatives.
Ensure adherence to security, compliance, and operational best practices.
Required Skills
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Knowledge of infrastructure management, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
Working knowledge of AI tools and AI-assisted development/productivity platforms.
Understanding of scripting or automation tools is an added advantage.
Strong problem-solving and communication skills.


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
